why_add_tilt_monitoring_when_we_already_: Why add tilt monitoring when we already inspect our racks?
inspections_assess_rack_condition_at_the: Inspections assess rack condition at the time of the visit. Tilt monitoring adds angle records between inspections, linked to a warehouse, aisle, bay and upright. This helps the team identify where a change occurred, review its history and hand over a specific point for inspection.
can_the_system_distinguish_loading_rebou: Can the system distinguish loading rebound, persistent tilt and impact?
configured_signal_processing_can_use_fil: Configured signal processing can use filtering, duration and return-to-baseline conditions to separate normal loading movement from persistent angle change and possible impact events. Validate each path against the supplied hardware, firmware and actual handling conditions. One-minute angle sampling alone cannot reliably capture a short impact; that requires a verified independent acquisition or wake-up path.
what_accuracy_and_alarm_thresholds_does_: What accuracy and alarm thresholds does our warehouse need?
accuracy_options_include_0_01_and_0_1_se: Accuracy options include ±0.01° and ±0.1°, selected against the meaningful change to be measured and verified under site conditions. Accuracy is not a safety limit. Set alert thresholds separately with the rack supplier or competent specialist, considering the accepted baseline, normal movement, mounting stability and response plan.
do_we_need_a_sensor_on_every_upright: Do we need a sensor on every upright?
point_selection_follows_the_rack_layout_: Point selection follows the rack layout, operating risks and monitoring objective. A representative pilot helps assess mounting, signal behaviour and communication before the final point schedule is agreed. Each sensor measures local orientation; do not assume it covers an entire row or detects every damaged component. Record unmonitored areas explicitly.
can_monitoring_replace_rack_inspections_: Can monitoring replace rack inspections or authorise return to use?
no_inspection_damage_reporting_repair_an: No. Inspection, damage reporting, repair and authorised return to use remain part of the site's safety procedure. Some damage produces no measurable tilt. An alert directs attention to a point; a normal reading does not establish rack safety, clear known damage or replace a competent assessment.
what_do_the_10_year_battery_profile_and_: What do the 10-year battery profile and 5M+ laboratory cycles mean?
the_h310_ts180c_reference_battery_profil: The H310-TS180C reference battery profile is 10 years at 25°C, with normal signal conditions, one-minute angle measurement and four-hour routine reporting. Actual life depends on the battery, temperature, network and event configuration; impact modes require a separate power assessment. The 5M+ laboratory measurement-cycle figure is a separate endurance measure, not a battery-life or field-life guarantee.
can_we_use_hitelecom_cloud_or_keep_data_: Can we use Hitelecom Cloud or keep data on a local platform?
selected_4g_or_nb_iot_terminals_connect_: Selected 4G or NB-IoT terminals connect through the operator network to Hitelecom Cloud. LoRa terminals use a compatible gateway, with cloud backhaul or an agreed local server and platform configuration. Confirm coverage, gateway power, data interfaces, retention and notification routes for the project, including behaviour during communication loss and recovery.
which_additional_sensors_should_we_inclu: Which additional sensors should we include?
add_temperature_and_humidity_sensing_for: Add temperature and humidity sensing for storage conditions, water-presence sensing at vulnerable points, and supported 4G smoke detectors where required. Select other channels only for a defined operational risk. Fire-panel alarm and fault-event integration is not included. Supporting data does not replace dedicated fire protection, personnel-safety equipment or local emergency procedures.
